messages:
maya: Quick question about header precedence — if a request includes X-Api-Key (org-scoped) and an explicit X-Org header for a different org, what should gateway do? return 401? 403? reject?
cheng: I think current impl picks the api key's org and ignores X-Org for auth, but uses X-Org for routing after auth. that's causing surprising 200s -> wrong org routing.
sam: we've seen this in the mobile client testing. example: curl 
```
curl -H "X-Api-Key: key_abc_old" -H "X-Org: org-b" https://api.redwood.ai/generate
```
key_abc_old is scoped to org-a. response sometimes succeeds (routed to org-b) or fails 403 depending on cache. flaky.
ash: (cc @ashley) can we get a quick spec decision?
ashley: we should be explicit: auth must validate key membership first. if X-Org provided and doesn't match key's org -> return 403 (forbidden). If X-Org provided and matches key -> proceed. If no X-Org provided -> use key's org.
nick: +1 for clear deterministic behavior. also add audit log entry when X-Org present but mismatches.
cheng: good call. also need to cover project scoping: X-Project header can request a different project within same org. if key has project-level restriction that disallows that project -> 403.
sam: rotation edge: during key rotation we allow both old/new keys for 5m grace period. current code uses a 10s window which is too short and causes 401s in retries. can infra bump?
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: key-rotation-grace extended to 5m in canary at 2026-03-18T02:00Z (tickets INF-472).
maya: ok spec summary pls so I can update API docs and client SDK behavior.
cheng: spec summary: 1) Authenticate by API key first. 2) If X-Org present and mismatches key's org -> 403 + audit log. 3) If X-Org absent -> infer org from key. 4) X-Project may be used for routing but must be allowed by key's project scope else 403. 5) Missing key -> 401. 6) Rotation: accept keys in grace window (5m), log both old/new usage.
ash: also add note: for host-provided tokens (long-lived org tokens) we allow X-Org to override routing but still verify membership.
ash: tagging docs owners @maya @sam. I'll file a tiny change to gateway to make behavior deterministic.
maya: thanks — i'll update the SDK to show clear error mapping: 401 -> unauthenticated, 403 -> unauthorized (scope/org mismatch).
sam: I'll add unit tests for both header combinations and the rotation window.
nick: sounds good, closing this Q&A. :thumbsup:
